summary: Modern Local ARTSOUP is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit gallery in Mars Hill supporting Appalachian artists; its Friday night 'ArtSoup' sessions are the venue's own recurring open-to-the-public programming (dance parties, tabletop games, live music, free hot soup, local sourdough and bagels), tied to Mars Hill's First Fridays but listed weekly. It is run by the gallery/nonprofit itself rather than by a club, and nothing in the listings or the org's own pages frames it as a membership community with returning regulars.

evidence.note: 9 near-identical weekly listings at the same gallery address describe a drop-in social night (dance parties, games, music, free soup) with no membership or sign-up language.
Description explicitly ties the event to Mars Hill's citywide First Fridays program rather than to a standalone club or membership group.

Official site identifies ARTSOUP as the nonprofit gallery's own name and mission (supporting local Appalachian artists), with the Friday nights described as public gallery programming, not a club roster.
Facebook page functions as the gallery/organization's public page, not a members-only group, and carries no membership or dues language.
